headline: Nigerian Stocks Up 60% in 2026 as Inflation Drops for Fourth Consecutive Month
summary: Nigeria's annual stock market index gain reached roughly 60% in November following four straight monthly declines in inflation. The Central Bank of Nigeria has begun cutting benchmark interest rates.
why: The Nigerian Exchange Group lists equities and fixed income securities for Africa's largest economy.

impacts.name: NGX All-Share
impacts.why: Easing consumer price inflation and rate cuts spurred broad buying across domestic Nigerian equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Easing inflation figures and central bank rate cuts encouraged equity market investment in Nigeria.
